grades.quote: If the log is marked as containing a complete operation, then the recovery code copies the writes to where they belong in the on-disk file system. If the log is not marked as containing a complete operation, the recovery code ignores the log.
grades.reason: Directly states the recovery decision: after reboot, the on-disk log is replayed if it is marked as containing a complete operation (the commit record was written). It is ignored if it is not so marked. The passage also explains why this makes operations atomic.
This real-world discussion criticizes xv6 logging efficiency and compares logging with fsck-style scavenging. It does not say how recovery decides whether to replay or discard the log.
